name: Yagiri Namie
source: Yagiri Namie is the former chief of Yagiri Pharmaceuticals and currently works as a secretary for Izaya Orihara. She tries to keep a professional mood between them but it is constantly undermined due to her obvious disdain for her new employer, as well as Izaya's flippant personality. She's also in love with her younger brother, Seiji.
